games.title: Benny's Sphere Splash
games.description: An underwater team sport in a giant sphere of water: pass, shoot and tackle, never on a timer. By Bryan R. with NARBE.

games.title: Chasing Rainbows
games.description: Inclusive Imagination®’s weather card game, in Full or Lite. Play the computer or share the switch with family.

games.title: NARBE Racer
games.description: Race sixteen tracks in four cups, with loop-de-loops, waterfalls and big jumps. Grand Prix, Time Trial and two players.

games.title: Benny's Ballista
games.description: Topple castles with boulders, bolts and bombs in three campaigns, or build your own in the Castle Workshop.

games.title: Benny Says
games.description: A simon says style game where you need to match the growing sequence every round

games.title: Benny's Baseball
games.description: A full baseball simluation game with no reaction needed, simply make choices and play a full season of baseball.

games.title: Benny's Basketball Shooter
games.description: Shoot hoops in a packed arena: chase a high score in the Shootout or play HORSE with a friend. Audio cues help you aim.

games.title: Benny's Football
games.description: Pick your team color, call your plays and time your passes through a 16-game season and the playoffs.

games.title: Robot Football
games.description: Lead a robot team through a 16-game season with live commentary. Call plays, pass, run and defend. No-fail practice.

games.title: Benny's Battle Boats
games.description: Place your fleet and sink the enemy's ships. Play the computer or challenge a friend in 2-player mode!

games.title: Benny's Bowling
games.description: Bowling with real physics for up to 4 players. Audio cues help you aim and charge each shot. Ten alley themes.

games.title: Benny's Bug Blaster
games.description: Tower defense: squash bugs with your boot and buy items to keep your defenses up.

games.title: Benny's Chess and Checkers
games.description: Play classic Chess or Checkers against the computer or with a friend!

games.title: Benny's Connect Four
games.description: Drop pieces and connect four in a row to win! Play against the computer or challenge a friend.

games.title: Benny's Matchy Match
games.description: A matching game with competitive and cooperative modes, plus an editor to make your own games!

games.title: Benny's P3GL Game
games.description: A glowing 3D peg shooter with 9 campaigns and 180 levels, from cozy to wild neon, plus a Campaign Editor.

games.title: Benny's Tic Tac Toe
games.description: Play tic tac toe against the computer or against your friends.

games.title: Benny's Dice
games.description: A 3D dice game with Free Throw, Yarkle, and Fahtzee modes. Roll dice with realistic physics!

games.title: Benny's Word Jumble
games.description: A word puzzle game where you have to rearrange the word to advance.

games.title: Elouise's Word Search
games.description: Find words hidden sideways, diagonally and backwards. 13 categories, over 1500 words, and an editor for your own lists.

games.title: Trivia Master
games.description: A trivia game engine that lets you build your own trivia games! Add pictures and videos to make it more fun!

games.title: Benny's Mega Slot
games.description: A fun casino-style slot machine game with bonus modes, multiple themes, and exciting sound effects!

games.title: NARBE Robot Pickleball
games.description: First-person robot pickleball with aimed serves, automatic returns and slow motion. With SCSU and Lily Flack.

games.title: Benny's Show n Sound
games.description: A spinning wheel See 'n Say. Pick a category, spin the wheel, and hear each panel's name and sound when it lands.

games.title: Benny's Race Tracks
games.description: Steer a car, motorcycle or spaceship with one switch through 10 levels, or relax in the no-fail Cruise mode.

games.title: NARBE Animal Friends
games.description: Open the barn, the aquarium or the safari and meet sixty animals, each with something to tell you. Nothing to lose.

games.title: Benny's Fish Mystery
games.description: Tag fish for the lake's research station, work up from a hand net to a motorboat, and solve the mystery of the lake.

games.title: NARBE Mini Golf
games.description: 3D mini golf for up to four players: three themed 18-hole courses, cinematic replays and a Course Creator.

games.title: NARBE Pet Pals
games.description: Adopt a puppy or a kitten and watch it grow up. Feed, play, cuddle, bathe and walk it, and decorate its home.

games.title: NARBE Magic Button
games.description: Press your switch to launch fireworks, blow bubbles or grow a garden of flowers. No score, no timer, nothing to lose.

games.title: Glow Pop
games.description: Pop a glowing ball, ladybug or bee into sparkles with a switch, key or tap. No score, no timer, nothing to lose.

games.title: Switch Stories
games.description: Illustrated stories that come to life with each press, with read-aloud, adjustable text and high contrast.

games.title: NARBE Loops
games.description: Build a colorful beat one spot at a time: add sound lines, change their sounds and save loops to play again.

games.title: NARBE Switch Songs
games.description: Play familiar songs one press at a time on a big piano with pictures, or explore Free Play. No score or timer.

games.title: NARBE Build n Bash
games.description: Build a house, a rocket, a castle and more block by block, then knock it down with a T. rex or a big sneeze!

games.title: NARBE Build n Ride
games.description: Ride a toy steam train through farms, mountains and a city at night, or build your own track. No score or timer.

games.title: Ben's Food Court
games.description: Run a mall food court: customers order, and you make each order one step at a time. Earn stars to open new restaurants.

games.title: NARBE Space Explorer
games.description: Fly a spaceship through a universe that never ends: orbit planets, meet aliens, warp to new galaxies. No score or timer.

games.title: NARBE Color Splash
games.description: Color 96 pages in eight coloring books, one press at a time, or pick every color yourself. No wrong colors, no timer.
